signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: Injective en BDACS plannen won-stablecoin voor tokenisering
signals.summary: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: American Bankers Association kritiseert OCC over definitieve stablecoin-beloningsregel
signals.summary: The fight between banks and crypto has reignited after a top banking regulator declined to weigh in on third-party stablecoin rewards.

signals.title: Cardano Foundation waarschuwt EU tegen uitbreiding MiCA naar DeFi en staking
signals.summary: The foundation called for regulation based on financial risks rather than technology, warning that overlapping rules could create uncertainty for crypto businesses across the EU.

signals.title: Stablecoin-transacties bereiken $400 miljoen per uur in Q3 2026
signals.summary:
Stablecoins Move $400M An Hour, With 73% Of Volume Outside Banking Hours: Coinbase 

                Authored by Nate Kostar via CoinTelegraph.com ,  

  Stablecoins moved more than $400 million an hour in adjusted transfer volume during the third quarter of 2026, as quarterly activity reached $891 billion, more than quadrupling since early 2023, according to a new report commissioned by Coinbase.  

     

 The report found that 73% of screened stablecoin transfer volume occurred outside US banking hours, including nights, weekends and holidays. 

     

  Distribution of stablecoin transfer volume by time of day. Source:    Coinbase and The Block Research, via Dune Analytics   

 Seven of the 10 largest US banks have tested stablecoins or tokenized deposits for settlement, while 30% of mid-market companies conducting cross-border business are using or piloting stablecoins, up from 10% in 2024. Business-to-business payment volume also rose 36% year over year. 

  Conducted by The Bloc

signals.title: OCC stelt definitieve regels GENIUS Act vast voor stablecoin-uitgevers
signals.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s final rule covers payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January.
